_comment: ta.mom / ta.roc warmup depth must match the TradingView chart history used for this export. The TV export's series origin is 2025-04-05 00:15 UTC (range-local deep-backtest seeding with zero pre-range history, findings 331-333); ta.mom(close,10) first goes live there at bar index 10 = 02:45 UTC, which is TV's first signal bar.
notes: Excellent (5690/5690 matched, coverage 100.0%). Previously strong on a single unit: count delta 0.0176% (abs=1), an ENGINE-ONLY trade at the range start (long entry 2025-04-05 02:45 @1819.50, exit 03:00 @1814.92). Under the default full-history 2020-origin warmup the engine has a valid mom[1] at 02:30 and correctly fires longCond there (mom -2.360 -> +5.510, roc +0.30375); TV's shorter series cannot produce that cross because its mom[1] at 02:30 is still na, so TV's first signal is instead the 02:45 shortCond (fill 03:00 @1814.92). Not an engine defect: ta::Mom::compute returns na until buffer_.size() >= length_+1 (first live at index length), matching Pine, and ta::Crossunder's is_na(prev_a) && !is_na(prev_b) -> (a < b) first-live-bar branch (src/ta_oscillators.cpp) is the Pine/pinets-faithful rule that fires TV's 02:45 cross. Origin established by oracle: a 61-run sweep of ohlcv_start_ms from 2025-04-04 12:00 to 2025-04-05 03:15 UTC, one 15m bar per step, has exactly one value that reproduces TV's trade list - 2025-04-05 00:15 UTC (1743812100000) gives 5690 trades whose first entry is TV's Entry short 2025-04-05 03:00 @1814.92; every earlier origin keeps the extra 02:45 trade (5691) and every later one drifts the first entry a bar per step. One non-gating divergence survives and is left alone: TV's final row carries Signal="Open", i.e. TV's data range ends 2026-04-05 20:45 UTC with the position open and books it at the range end (exit @2067.40) while the engine's feed continues to the real close at 21:15 (@2059.66). That is the finding-320 range-end unit class; it does not gate (exit p90 0.0000%, PnL p90 0.0782%) and there is no ohlcv_end_ms knob to trim it.
